abilities.name: oblivious
abilities.effect: Prevents infatuation and protects against captivate.

abilities.name: anticipation
abilities.effect: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, self destruct, explosion, or a one-hit KO move.

abilities.name: hydration
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

hoenn.flavorText: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the BARBOACH’s body.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its whiskers make a superb radar. They are used to locate prey, even in the murkiest of water.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

updated-johto.flavorText: BARBOACH uses its whiskers to taste things just as a person uses his or her tongue to taste things.

original-unova.flavorText: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

updated-unova.flavorText: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

kalos.flavorText: Its whiskers make a superb radar. They are used to locate prey, even in the murkiest of water.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Barboach’s body is covered with a slimy film. If a foe grabs it, this Pokémon just slips out of the enemy’s grip. This Pokémon grows weak if the slimy coating dries up.

original-alola.flavorText: Its slippery body is hard to grasp, so much so that there are festivals where people compete to see how many they can catch barehanded.

updated-alola.flavorText: Its whiskers are filled with nerves. They can sense smells and flavors just as a person’s nose or tongue would.

swsh.flavorText: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.
